recent.text: Good young player, really nice early returns on the 4th rounder for the Jets Need more of these kind of day 3 selections from the Jets to break the drought in 2027 and beyond.
recent.author: Will Parkinson
recent.quoted_text: Defensive tackles with 3+ run stops in five different games this season: Jordan Davis (JAX) Jeffery Simmons (CHI) Quinnen Williams (DAL) Tommy Togiai (HOU) LaCale London (ATL) Darrell Jackson Jr. (NYJ)
